summary: Five-phase plan for the spoken orchestration recap: a fourth per-session path resolver plus a new two-mode orchestrate-recap.sh (Phase 1), the user-only /recap command and skill with its CLAUDE.md row and the nvim TTS guide note (Phase 2), a nine-case test suite with its classification row (Phase 3), the conclusion-stage Step 6 amendment plus the Move 5 Bash allowlist entry and the results-template recommendation (Phase 4), and deploy/verify/acceptance (Phase 5). The user-only ruling is recorded explicitly with its structural rationale. Two gate collisions were found at authoring time and designed around via phase ordering.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase, 7-hour plan wiring a speech-shaped recap into the conclusion stage's emission step and a user-only /recap command that speaks or prints it.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh's suite_selection_select has UNION semantics across multiple path arguments: if ANY argument path has no mapped suite, the function returns the single __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel for the whole call, regardless of how many real suites the other paths map to. validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check calls it with a phase's entire harvested Files-to-modify list, so a plan phase that creates even one new file (or touches one unmapped markdown file) must assert __FULL_SWEEP__ in its Tier Justification, never a per-path suite list -- naming real suites there is flagged as a fabricated claim even when each name is individually correct. Author the sentinel claim plus a gate subset, and put the genuinely-mapped suite names in the phase's Verification block instead.
